items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know I played on it, though. Creed probably got me involved in that.

ctx.x: How about the one with Wes Montgomery, Down Here on the Ground?
I played on that? I just heard that on the radio today. I didn’t know I played on it, though. Creed probably got me involved in that. What year was that?
